visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a festive red velvet strapless bodysuit, black long gloves, and white fur-trimmed boots, runs frantically through a dark doorway into a dimly lit room. She grabs the camera, which shakes violently to simulate an earthquake. Her expression is wide-eyed and exaggerated with bright red lipstick. The background reveals a wooden floor, a black computer tower, and various glass bottles on a low cabinet. (2) The scene cuts to a different woman with lighter brown wavy hair, wearing a similar red Christmas-themed outfit with black garter straps and a white bow choker. She stands in a brightly lit kitchen area and addresses the camera directly with a seductive expression, touching her chest and moving her hands down her body. The background shows a white air conditioning unit and kitchen cabinets with bottles on the counter. (3) The woman sits down, bringing the camera closer to her lap while performing a playful dance. She smiles and pouts at the lens. Suddenly, her expression shifts; she widens her eyes and mouth into a large scream, lunging her gloved hands toward the camera lens in a mock aggressive grabbing motion, laughing wildly as the camera moves erratically.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched female voice shouts frantically in Mandarin about an earthquake. The speech is rapid and carries high emotional arousal. Background music consists of an upbeat electronic pop track with a heavy synthesized kick drum and rhythmic hi-hats. (2) The audio cuts to a second female voice speaking with a lower, more playful and seductive tone. She uses deliberate pauses and a breathy vocal texture. The upbeat pop BGM continues at a consistent volume. (3) The vocal switches back to a friendly, conversational tone, asking about the holiday. As the track reaches a transition, the speaker suddenly screams 'Qiangjie!' at a very high volume and intensity, followed by chaotic, high-pitched laughter. The spectral brightness peaks during this vocal outburst.
